methodology.task: Full travel-day plan: flight, hotel, calendar, weather, ground travel, timeline and readiness.
methodology.data: Synthetic personal fixtures and live Gemini inference; no real travel accounts.
methodology.modelToolArguments: Full registered schemas; every model argument is checked against application-owned input/result provenance.
methodology.sdk: Built package supplies observer, provider client, every lifecycle operation and signed execution over HTTP. No direct registry lifecycle calls.
methodology.usage: Reported tokens across every response, including reasoning; failed calls remain included and unknown usage remains null.
limitations: Small sample of a bounded single-flight/single-hotel workflow.
All four modes still perform the same underlying reads/calculations.
